message: Last week, we had a little storm warning, and you know what that means—our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree! Between my daughter sharing her favorite chili recipe and my son sending memes about being snowed in, I had a good laugh. But it also reminded me how important it is to keep a few essentials on hand, just in case we really needed them. I guess even in a storm, a little humor can help us weather the day! ☔️
